## Current interests

My research interests lie in analytic number theory, with an emphasis on applications of the Hardy--Littlewood circle method. Naturally this leads to interest in related problems in Fourier analysis, such as pointwise bounds on exponential sums, mean value estimates on exponential sums, and application of the geometry of numbers.

### Quantitative Hasse principle for forms in many variables
I am interested in quantitative forms of the Hasse principle for homogeneous and weighted-homogeneous equations.

### Applications to magic squares and multimagic squares

I am also interested in Diophantine systems arising from problems in recreational mathematics, including multimagic squares and magic squares of powers.

## Further directions

I am interested in learning more about arithmetic statistics, sieve methods, and additive combinatorics.
